findings.title: validateTag only rejects the space character, but import splits tags on any whitespace
findings.why: A tag with a tab or newline passes `validateTag` when added through `list.add` or `tag`, even though the project's own import treats `\s` as a separator. Tags can therefore exist that import could never produce.

findings.title: add reads the clock before the duplicate check
findings.why: `now()` is called in `createTask` before the duplicate check, so a rejected duplicate add still consumes a clock reading. This is harmless with the real clock. With an injected counting clock, as the tests use, a failed add shifts later timestamps.
